slides.headline: Connectivity is one safety layer
slides.body: Treat it as part of a governed process—not a guarantee.

slides.headline: Define acknowledgement
slides.body: Know how the device, worker and response team see message state.

slides.headline: Define escalation
slides.body: Set retry, alternate path and human escalation behaviour for each event class.

slides.headline: Define the unavailable state
slides.body: The product and procedure must make communication limits visible.

slides.headline: Assess the dependency
slides.body: Review the complete safety workflow with technical and risk owners.
